attractions.name: Cafe Sacher
attractions.description: Historic Viennese coffeehouse famed for inventing the original Sacher-Torte, paired with classic coffeehouse ambiance.

attractions.name: St. Stephen's Cathedral
attractions.description: Iconic Gothic cathedral at the heart of Vienna with a striking tiled roof, catacombs, and panoramic tower views.
attractions.cost_notes: Basic entry; tower or catacombs cost extra

attractions.name: Hofburg Palace
attractions.description: Former imperial palace complex with opulent state apartments, the Sisi Museum, and the Imperial Treasury.
attractions.cost_notes: Combined ticket for Sisi Museum and apartments

attractions.name: Albertina Museum
attractions.description: Renowned museum with an extensive graphic arts collection plus Monet, Picasso, and Klimt works, housed in a former Habsburg residence.

day_plans.getting_around_tip: All stops today are in the same area — easily walkable.

attractions.name: Kunsthistorisches Museum
attractions.description: World-class art museum housing the Habsburgs' collection, including works by Bruegel, Vermeer, and Raphael, set in a lavish palatial building.
attractions.cost_notes: Standard adult ticket, discounts for students/seniors

attractions.name: Leopold Museum
attractions.description: Modern art museum famous for the world's largest Egon Schiele collection plus works by Klimt and other Austrian Expressionists.

attractions.name: MuseumsQuartier Wien
attractions.description: One of the largest cultural districts in the world, combining museums, courtyards, cafes, and public art installations in a relaxed setting.
attractions.cost_notes: Free to wander the courtyards; individual museums charge entry

attractions.name: Naschmarkt
attractions.description: Vienna's most famous market street, packed with food stalls, spice vendors, and casual eateries offering both Austrian and international cuisine.
attractions.cost_notes: Cost varies by what you eat and buy
attractions.best_time_to_visit: Saturday morning for the flea market

day_plans.getting_around_tip: Today spans 2 areas (Museumsquartier, Mariahilf) — consider public transit or a taxi between stops.

attractions.name: Café Central
attractions.description: Grand historic cafe with soaring vaulted ceilings, once a haunt of Vienna's intellectuals, serving classic Viennese pastries and coffee.

attractions.name: Figlmüller
attractions.description: Legendary restaurant credited with popularizing Vienna's giant schnitzel, a mid-range must-try dining spot.
attractions.best_time_to_visit: Dinner, arrive early or book ahead

attractions.name: Belvedere Palace (Upper Belvedere)
attractions.description: Baroque palace and gallery home to Klimt's 'The Kiss' and an extensive collection of Austrian art from medieval to contemporary.

attractions.name: Prater & Wurstelprater Food Stalls
attractions.description: Historic amusement park area with the giant Ferris wheel, surrounded by traditional Austrian sausage stands and beer gardens.
attractions.cost_notes: Includes Ferris wheel ride and street food

day_plans.getting_around_tip: Today spans 3 areas (Innere Stadt, Landstraße, Leopoldstadt) — consider public transit or a taxi between stops.
